verdict.rationale: Poly is a file-storage and notes product with journaling and an editor, so a templates story fairly applies. The evidence pack never mentions reusable templates or variables such as date and title. Journal entries saved as Markdown files and the agent's ability to write files are adjacent features, not a template system, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can define reusable templates (with variables like date and title) and apply them when creating recurring kinds of notes
